run_mapanything_inference: run MapAnything 3D reconstruction inference on images from a folder using the CLI script
run_mapanything_apache_model: run MapAnything inference using the Apache 2.0 licensed model with the --apache flag
run_mapanything_with_rerun_viz: run MapAnything inference with Rerun 3D visualization enabled using the --viz flag
run_mapanything_save_glb: run MapAnything inference and export the 3D reconstruction as a GLB mesh file
run_mapanything_video_viz: run MapAnything inference with video-style Rerun visualization using the --video_viz_for_rerun flag
